### Data

#### Figure 2


```{r}

df <- read_excel("Primary analysis.xlsx", skip = 1)[,-c(11:13)]

```


```{r}
# --- Define which outcomes belong to which category ------------

maternal_health <- c(
  "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "Maternal infection",
  "Hysterectomy",
  "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
  "Maternal death",
  "Late maternal death"
)

obstetric_delivery <- c(
  "Preterm birth",
  "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
  "Birth without intervention",
  "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
  "Induction of labour (any)",
  "Augmentation of labour",
  "Instrumental birth",
  "Perineal tear",
  "Shoulder dystocia",
  "Caesarean section",
  "Emergency caesarean section",
  "Elective caesarean section"
)

child <- c(
  "APGAR",
  "Stillbirth",
  "Small for gestational age",
  "Large for gestational age",
  "Neonatal death",
  "Infant death"
)

mental_health <- c(
  "Postpartum depression",
  "Postpartum anxiety"
)

service_use <- c(
  "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "ICU admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "Length of stay 3-6 days",
  "Length of stay >=7 days",
  "Length of stay (continuous)",
  "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
  "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
  "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)"
)

# --- Harmonise variant names to the target labels --------------

df <- df %>%
  mutate(Outcome = recode(Outcome,
    "Length of stay (3-6 days)"           = "Length of stay 3-6 days",
    "Length of stay (>=7 days)"           = "Length of stay >=7 days",
    "Length of stay 3to7days v 0to2days"  = "Length of stay 3-6 days",
    "Length of stay 7plusdays v 0to2days" = "Length of stay >=7 days",
    "Postnatal stay (3-6 days)"           = "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
    "Postnatal stay (>=7 days)"           = "Postnatal stay >=7 days",

    "Caeserian section"             = "Caesarean section",
    "Caesarean section (elective)"  = "Elective caesarean section",
    "Caesarean section (emergency)" = "Emergency caesarean section",
    "Early maternal deaths"         = "Maternal death",
    "Late maternal deaths"          = "Late maternal death",
    "Epidural"                      = "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
    "Induction of labour"           = "Induction of labour (any)",
    "Premature rupture of membrane" = "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
    "Severe maternal morbidity"     = "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",

    "Hospital admission" = "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",

    "LGA" = "Large for gestational age",
    "SGA" = "Small for gestational age",

    "Postnatal depression" = "Postpartum depression",
    "Postnatal anxiety"    = "Postpartum anxiety"
  ))

# --- Assign category -------------------------------------------

df <- df %>%
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    Outcome %in% maternal_health    ~ "Maternal Health Outcomes",
    Outcome %in% obstetric_delivery ~ "Obstetric / Delivery Outcomes",
    Outcome %in% child              ~ "Infant/Child Outcomes",
    Outcome %in% mental_health      ~ "Maternal mental Health",
    Outcome %in% service_use        ~ "Service Utilisation Outcomes",
    TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  relocate(Category, .before = Outcome)

# --- Report any outcomes that didn't match ---------------------

unmatched <- df %>%
  filter(is.na(Category), !is.na(Outcome)) %>%
  pull(Outcome) %>%
  unique()

if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  message("Outcomes not matched to a category:")
  print(unmatched)
} else {
  message("All outcomes assigned to a category.")
}



```



```{r}
# --- Create Outcome2 as an ordered factor ----------------------
# Levels follow the order in the original labels list:
# Obstetric / Maternal -> Child -> Mental Health -> Service Use
outcome_levels <- c(maternal_health,obstetric_delivery, child, mental_health, service_use)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_levels)) 


```


```{r}

names(df) = c("Category","Outcome","EventsInUnexposed","Unexposed","EventsInExposed","Exposed","RR","LL","UL","Model","Dataset")

```

```{r}
df = subset(df,!is.na(df$RR))

# df$RR = round(as.numeric(df$RR),2)
# df$LL = round(as.numeric(df$LL),2)
# df$UL = round(as.numeric(df$UL),2)


round_excel <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  scale <- 10^digits
  floor(x * scale + 0.5) / scale
}


x = df
x$LL0 = round(x$LL,2)
x$LL1=round_excel(x$LL, 2)

k = x %>% dplyr::select(Outcome,LL,LL0,LL1,Dataset)
k$check = ifelse(k$LL0==k$LL1,1,0)

x = df
x$RR0 = round(x$RR,2)
x$RR1=round_excel(x$RR, 2)

k = x %>% dplyr::select(Outcome,RR,RR0,RR1,Dataset)
k$check = ifelse(k$RR0==k$RR1,1,0)


x = df
x$UL0 = round(x$UL,2)
x$UL1=round_excel(x$UL, 2)

k = x %>% dplyr::select(Outcome,UL,UL0,UL1,Dataset)
k$check = ifelse(k$UL0==k$UL1,1,0)


df$RR = round_excel(df$RR,3)
df$LL = round_excel(df$LL,3)
df$UL = round_excel(df$UL,3)


```


```{r}
# Convert HR to log(HR) and compute standard error
df$logRR <- log(df$RR)
df$SE <- (log(df$UL) - log(df$LL)) / (2 * 1.96)

df = subset(df,!is.na(df$SE))

df = data.frame(df)

```

##### Split into FOUR

###### Obstetric / Delivery Outcomes 

```{r}

df1 = filter(df,Category %in% c("Obstetric / Delivery Outcomes"))
# Perform meta-analysis with Dataset as subgroups
meta_result <- metagen(TE = logRR, 
                       seTE = SE, 
                       studlab = Dataset, 
                       data = df1, 
                       sm = "RR", 
                       method.tau = "REML",
                       byvar = Outcome,
                       comb.fixed = F,  
                       comb.random = T,
                       overall = FALSE,
                       print.subgroup = TRUE)  

# Generate forest plot by Dataset

jpeg("Figure 2 Obstetric or Delivery Outcomes.jpg", width = 1800, height = 3150, res = 150)

forest(meta_result, 
       leftcols = c("Dataset", "EventsInUnexposed","Unexposed","EventsInExposed","Exposed"), 
       leftlabs = c("Dataset", "EventsInUnexposed","Unexposed","EventsInExposed","Exposed"),
       rightcols = c("effect", "ci", "w.random"),
       rightlabs = c("RR", "95% CI", "Weight"),
       print.byvar = TRUE,  
       colgap.forest = "4mm",
       overall.hetstat = FALSE,
       test.subgroup = FALSE) 

dev.off()

```

```{r}
df = subset(df,!is.na(df$RR))

# df$RR = round(as.numeric(df$RR),2)
# df$LL = round(as.numeric(df$LL),2)
# df$UL = round(as.numeric(df$UL),2)


round_excel <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  scale <- 10^digits
  floor(x * scale + 0.5) / scale
}


x = df
x$LL0 = round(x$LL,2)
x$LL1=round_excel(x$LL, 2)

k = x %>% dplyr::select(Outcome,LL,LL0,LL1,Dataset)
k$check = ifelse(k$LL0==k$LL1,1,0)

x = df
x$RR0 = round(x$RR,2)
x$RR1=round_excel(x$RR, 2)

k = x %>% dplyr::select(Outcome,RR,RR0,RR1,Dataset)
k$check = ifelse(k$RR0==k$RR1,1,0)


x = df
x$UL0 = round(x$UL,2)
x$UL1=round_excel(x$UL, 2)

k = x %>% dplyr::select(Outcome,UL,UL0,UL1,Dataset)
k$check = ifelse(k$UL0==k$UL1,1,0)


df$RR = round_excel(df$RR,3)
df$LL = round_excel(df$LL,3)
df$UL = round_excel(df$UL,3)


```


```{r}
# Convert HR to log(HR) and compute standard error
df$logRR <- log(df$RR)
df$SE <- (log(df$UL) - log(df$LL)) / (2 * 1.96)

df = subset(df,!is.na(df$SE))

df = data.frame(df)

```

##### Split into FOUR

###### Obstetric / Delivery Outcomes 

```{r}

df1 = filter(df,Category %in% c("Obstetric / Delivery Outcomes"))
# Perform meta-analysis with Dataset as subgroups
meta_result <- metagen(TE = logRR, 
                       seTE = SE, 
                       studlab = Dataset, 
                       data = df1, 
                       sm = "RR", 
                       method.tau = "REML",
                       byvar = Outcome,
                       comb.fixed = F,  
                       comb.random = T,
                       overall = FALSE,
                       print.subgroup = TRUE)  

# Generate forest plot by Dataset

jpeg("Figure 4 Obstetric or Delivery Outcomes.jpg", width = 1800, height = 3150, res = 150)

forest(meta_result, 
       leftcols = c("Dataset", "EventsInUnexposed","Unexposed","EventsInExposed","Exposed"), 
       leftlabs = c("Dataset", "EventsInUnexposed","Unexposed","EventsInExposed","Exposed"),
       rightcols = c("effect", "ci", "w.random"),
       rightlabs = c("RR", "95% CI", "Weight"),
       print.byvar = TRUE,  
       colgap.forest = "4mm",
       overall.hetstat = FALSE,
       test.subgroup = FALSE) 

dev.off()

```

```{r}

maternal_health <- c(
  "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "Maternal infection",
  "Hysterectomy",
  "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
  "Maternal death",
  "Late maternal death"
)

obstetric_delivery <- c(
  "Preterm birth",
  "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
  "Birth without intervention",
  "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
  "Induction of labour (any)",
  "Augmentation of labour",
  "Instrumental birth",
  "Perineal tear",
  "Shoulder dystocia",
  "Caesarean section",
  "Emergency caesarean section",
  "Elective caesarean section"
)

child <- c(
  "APGAR",
  "Stillbirth",
  "Small for gestational age",
  "Large for gestational age",
  "Neonatal death",
  "Infant death"
)

mental_health <- c(
  "Postpartum depression",
  "Postpartum anxiety"
)

service_use <- c(
  "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "ICU admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "Length of stay 3-6 days",
  "Length of stay >=7 days",
  "Length of stay (continuous)",
  "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
  "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
  "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)"
)

outcome_levels <- c(
  maternal_health,
  obstetric_delivery,
  child,
  mental_health,
  service_use
)

categorise_outcomes <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Outcome = recode(
      Outcome,
      "Length of stay (3-6 days)"           = "Length of stay 3-6 days",
      "Length of stay 3 to 6 days"          = "Length of stay 3-6 days",
      "Length of stay (>=7 days)"           = "Length of stay >=7 days",
      "Length of stay >= 7 days"            = "Length of stay >=7 days",
      "Length of stay 3to7days v 0to2days"  = "Length of stay 3-6 days",
      "Length of stay 7plusdays v 0to2days" = "Length of stay >=7 days",

      "Postnatal stay (3-6 days)"           = "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
      "Postnatal stay 3 to 6 days"          = "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
      "Postnatal stay (>=7 days)"           = "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
      "Postnatal stay >= 7 days"            = "Postnatal stay >=7 days",

      "Caeserian section"                   = "Caesarean section",
      "Caeserean section"                   = "Caesarean section",
      "C-Section (All)"                     = "Caesarean section",
      "Caesarean section (elective)"        = "Elective caesarean section",
      "C-Section (Elective)"                = "Elective caesarean section",
      "Caesarean section (emergency)"       = "Emergency caesarean section",
      "C-Section (Emergency)"               = "Emergency caesarean section",

      "Early maternal deaths"               = "Maternal death",
      "Late maternal deaths"                = "Late maternal death",
      "Epidural"                            = "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
      "Induction of labour"                 = "Induction of labour (any)",
      "Induction of Labour"                 = "Induction of labour (any)",
      "Premature rupture of membrane"       = "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
      "Severe maternal morbidity"           = "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
      "Severe Maternal Morbidity"           = "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
      "Preterm Birth"                       = "Preterm birth",
      "Spontaneous Vaginal Birth"           = "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
      "Instrumental Birth"                  = "Instrumental birth",

      "Hospital admission"                  = "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",

      "LGA"                                 = "Large for gestational age",
      "SGA"                                 = "Small for gestational age",
      "Infant Death"                        = "Infant death",
      "Neonatal Death"                      = "Neonatal death",

      "Postnatal depression"                = "Postpartum depression",
      "postnatal depression"                = "Postpartum depression",
      "Postnatal anxiety"                   = "Postpartum anxiety",
      "postnatal anxiety"                   = "Postpartum anxiety"
    )) %>%
    mutate(Category = case_when(
      Outcome %in% maternal_health    ~ "Maternal Health Outcomes",
      Outcome %in% obstetric_delivery ~ "Obstetric / Delivery Outcomes",
      Outcome %in% child              ~ "Infant/Child Outcomes",
      Outcome %in% mental_health      ~ "Maternal mental Health",
      Outcome %in% service_use        ~ "Service Utilisation Outcomes",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_levels)) %>%
    relocate(Category, .before = Outcome)
}

report_unmatched <- function(df, label) {
  unmatched <- df %>%
    filter(is.na(Category), !is.na(Outcome)) %>%
    pull(Outcome) %>%
    unique()

  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("[%s] Outcomes not matched to a category:", label))
    print(unmatched)
  } else {
    message(sprintf("[%s] All outcomes assigned to a category.", label))
  }
}
```

```{r}

subgroup_estimates <- list()

for (group in unique(df$Outcome)) {
  sub_df <- df %>% filter(Outcome == group)
  
  m <- metagen(
    TE = logRR,
    seTE = SE,
    studlab = Dataset,
    data = sub_df,
    sm = "RR",
    method.tau = "REML",
    comb.fixed = FALSE,
    comb.random = TRUE
  )
  
  subgroup_estimates[[group]] <- data.frame(
    Outcome = group,
    RR = round(exp(m$TE.random), 2),
    Lower_CI = round(exp(m$lower.random), 2),
    Upper_CI = round(exp(m$upper.random), 2),
  tau2 = m$tau2,
  I2 = m$I2,
  Q = m$Q,
  pval = m$pval.Q
  )
}


df_subgroups <- bind_rows(subgroup_estimates)

# Add formatted heterogeneity column
df_subgroups$Heterogeneity <- sprintf(
  "Heterogeneity: %.1f%%, tau² = %.5f, p = %s",
  df_subgroups$I2*100,
  df_subgroups$tau2,
  format.pval(df_subgroups$pval, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
)

write_xlsx(df_subgroups[,c(1,9)], "0 vs 1_heterogeneity.xlsx")
write_xlsx(df_subgroups[,c(1:4)], "0 vs 1_meta_results.xlsx")


zero_vs_one_pooled = df_subgroups[,c(1:4)]
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)

# Install once if needed:
# install.packages("gridExtra")

library(gridExtra)

panel_size <- unit(3, "in")


# 1. Select pooled data ----------------------------------------------------

df <- subset(figure3_data, Dataset == "Pooled")


# 2. Harmonise outcome names ----------------------------------------------

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = trimws(as.character(Outcome)),
    Outcome = dplyr::recode(
      Outcome,
      "Length of stay (3-6 days)" =
        "Length of stay 3-6 days",
      "Length of stay (>=7 days)" =
        "Length of stay >=7 days",
      "Length of stay 3to7days v 0to2days" =
        "Length of stay 3-6 days",
      "Length of stay 7plusdays v 0to2days" =
        "Length of stay >=7 days",
      "Postnatal stay (3-6 days)" =
        "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
      "Postnatal stay (>=7 days)" =
        "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
      "Caeserian section" =
        "Caesarean section",
      "Caesarean section (elective)" =
        "Elective caesarean section",
      "Caesarean section (emergency)" =
        "Emergency caesarean section",
      "Early maternal deaths" =
        "Maternal death",
      "Late maternal deaths" =
        "Late maternal death",
      "Epidural" =
        "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
      "Induction of labour" =
        "Induction of labour (any)",
      "Premature rupture of membrane" =
        "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
      "Severe maternal morbidity" =
        "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
      "Hospital admission" =
        "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
      "LGA" =
        "Large for gestational age",
      "SGA" =
        "Small for gestational age",
      "Postnatal depression" =
        "Postpartum depression",
      "Postnatal anxiety" =
        "Postpartum anxiety",
      .default = Outcome
    ),
    MM_Definition = factor(
      trimws(as.character(MM_Definition)),
      levels = c("1", "2", "3+")
    )
  )


# 3. Define groups ---------------------------------------------------------

maternal_health <- c(
  "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "Maternal infection",
  "Hysterectomy",
  "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
  "Maternal death",
  "Late maternal death"
)

obstetric_delivery <- c(
  "Preterm birth",
  "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
  "Birth without intervention",
  "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
  "Induction of labour (any)",
  "Augmentation of labour",
  "Instrumental birth",
  "Perineal tear",
  "Shoulder dystocia",
  "Caesarean section",
  "Emergency caesarean section",
  "Elective caesarean section"
)

child <- c(
  "APGAR",
  "Stillbirth",
  "Small for gestational age",
  "Large for gestational age",
  "Neonatal death",
  "Infant death"
)

mental_health <- c(
  "Postpartum depression",
  "Postpartum anxiety"
)

service_use <- c(
  "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "ICU admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "Length of stay 3-6 days",
  "Length of stay >=7 days",
  "Length of stay (continuous)",
  "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
  "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
  "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)"
)

outcome_groups <- list(
  "A. Maternal health" = maternal_health,
  "B. Obstetric and delivery outcomes" = obstetric_delivery,
  "C. Infant and child outcomes" = child,
  "D. Mental health" = mental_health,
  "E. Service use" = service_use
)

unmatched <- setdiff(
  unique(df$Outcome),
  unlist(outcome_groups, use.names = FALSE)
)

if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  stop("Unassigned outcomes: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
}


# 4. Create grouped plots --------------------------------------------------

make_group_plot <- function(group_title, outcomes) {

  plot_data <- df %>%
    filter(Outcome %in% outcomes) %>%
    mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcomes))

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = MM_Definition,
      y = RR,
      group = MM_Definition,
      colour = MM_Definition
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_dodge(0.9),
      size = 8
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "red",
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 3
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = LL, ymax = UL),
      width = 0.2,
      linewidth = 3,
      position = position_dodge(0.9)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~Outcome,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 3,
      labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 16)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = function(x) {
        c(0.5, ceiling(max(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10)
      },
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
      oob = scales::oob_keep
    ) +
    labs(
      title = group_title,
      x = "Number of conditions",
      y = "Relative Risk (95% CI)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(
        size = 25, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 30,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(b = 15)
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 25,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(8, 5, 8, 5)
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 25, face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 25),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 25
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "in"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 25, 10)
    )
}

group_plots <- Map(
  make_group_plot,
  names(outcome_groups),
  outcome_groups
)


# 5. Give every outcome an equal square plotting area ----------------------

make_square_grob <- function(p) {

  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

  panel_index <- grepl("^panel($|-)", g$layout$name)

  panel_columns <- unique(g$layout$l[panel_index])
  panel_rows <- unique(g$layout$t[panel_index])

  g$widths[panel_columns] <- rep(
    panel_size, length(panel_columns)
  )

  g$heights[panel_rows] <- rep(
    panel_size, length(panel_rows)
  )

  g
}

group_grobs <- lapply(group_plots, make_square_grob)


# 6. Measure the content and align groups to the left -----------------------

group_widths <- vapply(
  group_grobs,
  function(g) {
    convertWidth(sum(g$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  },
  numeric(1)
)

group_heights <- vapply(
  group_grobs,
  function(g) {
    convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  },
  numeric(1)
)

# Use the actual content dimensions rather than a large fixed canvas
figure_width <- max(group_widths)
figure_height <- sum(group_heights)

# Position each group at the top-left of its allocated section
aligned_grobs <- lapply(
  seq_along(group_grobs),
  function(i) {
    grobTree(
      group_grobs[[i]],
      vp = viewport(
        x = unit(0, "npc"),
        y = unit(1, "npc"),
        width = unit(group_widths[i], "in"),
        height = unit(group_heights[i], "in"),
        just = c("left", "top")
      )
    )
  }
)

final_plot <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  grobs = aligned_grobs,
  ncol = 1,
  widths = unit(figure_width, "in"),
  heights = unit(group_heights, "in"),
  padding = unit(0, "in")
)


# 7. Save -----------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure3_Pooled_Five_Groups.jpeg",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = figure_width,
  height = figure_height,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  limitsize = FALSE,
  bg = "white"
)

# A small RStudio plotting pane may not fit the full figure.
# View the saved image to inspect the complete layout.
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Select pooled data ----------------------------------------------------

df <- subset(figure3_data, Dataset == "Pooled")


# 2. Harmonise outcome names ----------------------------------------------

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = trimws(as.character(Outcome)),
    Outcome = dplyr::recode(
      Outcome,
      "Length of stay (3-6 days)" =
        "Length of stay 3-6 days",
      "Length of stay (>=7 days)" =
        "Length of stay >=7 days",
      "Length of stay 3to7days v 0to2days" =
        "Length of stay 3-6 days",
      "Length of stay 7plusdays v 0to2days" =
        "Length of stay >=7 days",
      "Postnatal stay (3-6 days)" =
        "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
      "Postnatal stay (>=7 days)" =
        "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
      "Caeserian section" =
        "Caesarean section",
      "Caesarean section (elective)" =
        "Elective caesarean section",
      "Caesarean section (emergency)" =
        "Emergency caesarean section",
      "Early maternal deaths" =
        "Maternal death",
      "Late maternal deaths" =
        "Late maternal death",
      "Epidural" =
        "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
      "Induction of labour" =
        "Induction of labour (any)",
      "Premature rupture of membrane" =
        "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
      "Severe maternal morbidity" =
        "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
      "Hospital admission" =
        "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
      "LGA" =
        "Large for gestational age",
      "SGA" =
        "Small for gestational age",
      "Postnatal depression" =
        "Postpartum depression",
      "Postnatal anxiety" =
        "Postpartum anxiety",
      .default = Outcome
    ),
    MM_Definition = factor(
      trimws(as.character(MM_Definition)),
      levels = c("1", "2", "3+")
    )
  )


# 3. Define outcome groups -------------------------------------------------

maternal_health <- c(
  "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "Maternal infection",
  "Hysterectomy",
  "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
  "Maternal death",
  "Late maternal death"
)

obstetric_delivery <- c(
  "Preterm birth",
  "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
  "Birth without intervention",
  "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
  "Induction of labour (any)",
  "Augmentation of labour",
  "Instrumental birth",
  "Perineal tear",
  "Shoulder dystocia",
  "Caesarean section",
  "Emergency caesarean section",
  "Elective caesarean section"
)

child <- c(
  "APGAR",
  "Stillbirth",
  "Small for gestational age",
  "Large for gestational age",
  "Neonatal death",
  "Infant death"
)

mental_health <- c(
  "Postpartum depression",
  "Postpartum anxiety"
)

service_use <- c(
  "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "ICU admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "Length of stay 3-6 days",
  "Length of stay >=7 days",
  "Length of stay (continuous)",
  "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
  "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
  "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)"
)

outcome_groups <- list(
  "A. Maternal health" = maternal_health,
  "B. Obstetric and delivery outcomes" = obstetric_delivery,
  "C. Infant and child outcomes" = child,
  "D. Mental health" = mental_health,
  "E. Service use" = service_use
)

unmatched <- setdiff(
  unique(df$Outcome),
  unlist(outcome_groups, use.names = FALSE)
)

if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  stop("Unassigned outcomes: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
}


# 4. Create grouped plots --------------------------------------------------

make_group_plot <- function(group_title, outcomes) {

  plot_data <- df %>%
    filter(Outcome %in% outcomes) %>%
    mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcomes))

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = MM_Definition,
      y = RR,
      group = MM_Definition,
      colour = MM_Definition
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_dodge(0.9),
      size = 8
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "red",
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 3
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = LL, ymax = UL),
      width = 0.2,
      linewidth = 3,
      position = position_dodge(0.9)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~Outcome,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 3,
      labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 32)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = function(x) {
        c(0.5, ceiling(max(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10)
      },
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
      oob = scales::oob_keep
    ) +
    labs(
      title = group_title,
      x = "Number of conditions",
      y = "Relative Risk (95% CI)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(
        size = 25, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 30,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(b = 12)
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 25,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(8, 5, 8, 5)
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 25, face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 25),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 25
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 15, 5)
    )
}

group_plots <- Map(
  make_group_plot,
  names(outcome_groups),
  outcome_groups
)


# 5. Combine groups using the available figure space -----------------------

group_rows <- vapply(
  outcome_groups,
  function(outcomes) {
    ceiling(sum(outcomes %in% unique(df$Outcome)) / 3)
  },
  numeric(1)
)

# Extra allowance for each group's heading and axis titles
final_plot <- wrap_plots(
  group_plots,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = group_rows + 0.5
)

print(final_plot)


# 6. Save at the requested full dimensions ---------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure3_Pooled_Five_Groups.jpeg",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 30,
  height = 49,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
upper_limit <- function(x) {
  max(1.1, ceiling(max(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10)
}

standard_limits <- function(x) {
  c(0.5, upper_limit(x))

}

          limits = mortality_limits,
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
        ),

      TRUE ~
        scale_y_continuous(
          limits = standard_limits,
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
        )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of conditions",

    ),

  )
```

```{r}
        "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
      "Hospital admission" =
        "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
      "LGA" =
        "Large for gestational age",
      "SGA" =
        "Small for gestational age",
      "Postnatal depression" =
        "Postpartum depression",
      "Postnatal anxiety" =
        "Postpartum anxiety",
      .default = Outcome
    ),
    MM_Definition = factor(
      trimws(as.character(MM_Definition)),
      levels = c("1", "2", "3+")
    )
  )


# 3. Set outcome ordering --------------------------------------------------

outcome_order <- c(
  # Maternal health
  "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "Maternal infection",
  "Hysterectomy",
  "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
  "Maternal death",
  "Late maternal death",

  # Obstetric and delivery outcomes
  "Preterm birth",
  "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
  "Birth without intervention",
  "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
  "Induction of labour (any)",
  "Augmentation of labour",
  "Instrumental birth",
  "Perineal tear",
  "Shoulder dystocia",
  "Caesarean section",
  "Emergency caesarean section",
  "Elective caesarean section",

  # Infant and child outcomes
  "APGAR",
  "Stillbirth",
  "Small for gestational age",
  "Large for gestational age",
  "Neonatal death",
  "Infant death",

  # Mental health
  "Postpartum depression",
  "Postpartum anxiety",

  # Service use
  "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "ICU admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "Length of stay 3-6 days",
  "Length of stay >=7 days",
  "Length of stay (continuous)",
  "Postnatal stay 3-6 days",
  "Postnatal stay >=7 days",
  "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)"
)

unmatched <- setdiff(unique(df$Outcome), outcome_order)

if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  stop("Unassigned outcomes: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_order))


# 4. Define dynamic limits -------------------------------------------------

dynamic_limits <- function(x) {

  # Include the reference value of 1 in every panel
  values <- c(x[is.finite(x)], 1)

  lower <- min(values)
  upper <- max(values)

  # Add 10% padding; minimum padding of 0.02
  padding <- max((upper - lower) * 0.10, 0.02)

  c(
    max(0, lower - padding),
    upper + padding
  )
}


# 5. Plot all outcomes with independent y-axis limits -----------------------

all_outcomes_plot <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(
    x = MM_Definition,
    y = RR,
    group = MM_Definition,
    colour = MM_Definition
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    size = 8
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    colour = "red",
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 3
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = LL, ymax = UL),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 3,
    position = position_dodge(0.9)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Outcome,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3,
    labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 32)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = dynamic_limits,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)),
    oob = scales::oob_keep
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of conditions",
    y = "Relative Risk (95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      size = 35, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 25,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(8, 5, 8, 5)
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 35, face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 25
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

print(all_outcomes_plot)


# 6. Save as a separate version -------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure3_Pooled_All_Outcomes_Dynamic_Axes.jpeg",
  plot = all_outcomes_plot,
  width = 30,
  height = 49,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

#### Saving pooled data

```{r}
pooled_data = subset(figure3_data,figure3_data$Dataset=="Pooled")

pooled_data <- pooled_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Estimate_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", RR, LL, UL)  # Format as text
  )

pooled_data = pooled_data %>% dplyr::select(Outcome,Model,Estimate_CI)

heterogeneity_o_vs_1 = read_excel("0 vs 1_heterogeneity.xlsx") %>% dplyr::mutate(Model = "0 vs 1")
heterogeneity_o_vs_2 = read_excel("0 vs 2_heterogeneity.xlsx") %>% dplyr::mutate(Model = "0 vs 2")
heterogeneity_o_vs_3 = read_excel("0 vs 3+_heterogeneity.xlsx") %>% dplyr::mutate(Model = "0 vs 3")

heterog_data = rbind(heterogeneity_o_vs_1,heterogeneity_o_vs_2,heterogeneity_o_vs_3)

pooled_data = left_join(pooled_data,heterog_data,by=c("Outcome","Model"))

write.csv(pooled_data,"Figure 3 Pooled Estimates.csv",row.names = F)
```

### Figure 3: Another way


#### All variables

```{r}
figure3_data2 = figure3_data

figure3_data2$Dataset = factor(figure3_data2$Dataset,levels = c("Pooled","Scotland routine health records","SAIL","NI","CPRD","Born in Bradford"))

```


```{r}
# Define x-axis limits (e.g., -1.5 to 1.5)
x_min <- 0
x_max <- 3.6
x_max2 <- 5

```

```{r}
figure3_data2 <- figure3_data2 %>%
  mutate(
    lower_trunc = ifelse(LL < x_min, x_min, LL),  # Truncate lower bound
    upper_trunc = ifelse(UL > x_max, x_max, UL),  # Truncate upper bound
    lower_arrow = LL < x_min,   # Flag for lower-bound truncation
    upper_arrow = UL > x_max    # Flag for upper-bound truncation
  )

# Add a formatted column with Estimate (95% CI)
figure3_data2 <- figure3_data2 %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", RR, LL, UL)  # Format as text
  )

```



```{r}

figure3_data2$UL = ifelse(figure3_data2$UL>4,3.5,figure3_data2$UL)
figure3_data2$LL = ifelse(figure3_data2$LL>4,3.5,figure3_data2$LL)
figure3_data2$RR = ifelse(figure3_data2$RR>4,3.5,figure3_data2$RR)


p1=ggplot(figure3_data2, aes(y = Dataset, x = RR, group=MM_Definition, color=MM_Definition)) +
  # Add the "Estimate (95% CI)" column
  geom_text(aes(x = 4 + 0.5, label = Estimate_CI),  # Adjust position
            position=position_dodge(0.5), size = 10,color = "black",fontface="bold") +  # Align text left
  geom_point(size = 8,position=position_dodge(0.5)) +                              # Effect size points
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = LL, xmax = UL),    # Confidence intervals
                 height = 0.4,linewidth=3,width=0.2,size=3,
                 position=position_dodge(0.5)) +
  
  # Add arrows for truncated lower CIs
  geom_segment(data = figure3_data2[figure3_data2$lower_arrow, ], 
               aes(x = x_min, xend = x_min - 0.1, y = Dataset, yend = Dataset),
               arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(1, "cm")),
               color = "black",size=3) +
  
  # Add arrows for truncated upper CIs
  geom_segment(data = figure3_data2[figure3_data2$upper_arrow, ], 
               aes(x = x_max, xend = x_max+0.1, y = Dataset, yend = Dataset),
               arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(1, "cm")),
               color = "black",size=3) +
  

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",size=3) +  # Reference line at 0
  #scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +    # Color coding
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Relative Risk", y = "Variable", color = "Transition") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max2)) + # Set x-axis limits# Remove redundant legend
  facet_wrap(~Outcome, scales = "free_x") + # Separate plots for each modeltheme_bw()+
  theme(text = element_text(size=50,face="bold",hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title=element_text(size=50,face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1,vjust = 1,size = 40),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30),
        axis.text=element_text(size=50))

ggsave(p1,filename = "Figure 3 ALL_Version2 140725.jpeg",width = 49,height = 49, dpi=300)

ggsave(p1,filename = "Figure 3 V2.jpeg",width = 49,height = 49, dpi=300)
```
